title: Account opening for a digital bank
problem: Identity checks failed often and people gave up before their account was open.
constraints: Regulatory wording for consent could not change
ID vendor SDK fixed the camera screen

decisions.choice: Ask for ID before personal details
decisions.why: Most failures came from ID; failing early wasted less of people's time

outcomes.text: Compliance found the new consent flow clearer to audit

assets.alt: First onboarding step: open an account, with your details and ID verification listed
ID step: choose passport or driving licence before taking a photo
